title: The same patient at two degrees of inspiration
question: After confirming matched reconstruction and comparable final model framing, how much does CT-CLIP's emphysema score change between inspiratory and expiratory breath-hold CT acquired from the same patient in one session, as measured lung volume changes?
deliverable_sentence: Conditional on a positive result: The model is using degree of inspiration - the lung's inflation state, measured as total lung volume in litres - as a component of its emphysema score.
why_it_matters: Radiologists routinely account for inspiratory effort. If a report-trained CT model's emphysema score changes materially with breath-hold state in the same patient, score comparability may depend on acquisition state even though disease is unchanged.

claim_boundaries.claimed: Use of the bundled physiological state degree of inspiration in the emphysema score.
not_claimed: Which visual channel within respiratory state carries the signal, including attenuation, vessel crowding, diaphragm position, or dependent opacity.
That a score change is a changed clinical diagnosis.
That the result generalizes beyond sharp-kernel radiotherapy-planning CT.
That 4DCT phases are calibrated inflation levels or identify a dose response.

rung.why: The paired acquisition can establish that the model uses signal changing with degree of inspiration. The named state-level rung-3 sentence is conditional on Stage 0 passing, a prespecified positive result, and successful exclusion of the principal acquisition and framing alternatives.
rung.what_would_move_it_up: Pass the DICOM-to-final-tensor comparability gate, observe a prespecified emphysema-score effect that exceeds the equivalence margin in the expected direction, and show that reconstruction, framing, and broad pipeline jitter do not plausibly explain it. Replication on a softer-kernel diagnostic cohort would strengthen rung 2 and external validity.

X_measurement.X: Degree of inspiration, operationalized as automatically segmented total lung volume in litres.
X_measurement.how: Use a pinned automatic lung segmentation tool, compute segmented voxel count times physical voxel volume, and record segmentation quality-control failures without radiologist adjudication. Mean lung attenuation and LAA%-950 are descriptive context only, not co-primary concepts.
X_measurement.could_I_compute_it_today_without_asking_: Yes. It is a voxel-based measurement from an automatic lung mask and DICOM geometry; no human concept annotation is required.

keystone_prerequisite: A prespecified sufficient number of actual inhale/exhale pairs are reconstruction-matched and preserve comparable coordinates, physical scale, thoracic coverage, crop loss, and padding through the complete pinned CT-CLIP preprocessing pipeline.
keystone_evidence: The TCIA collection record verifies 20 same-session inhale/exhale BHCT acquisitions. Direct NBIA index inspection found one nominal 2.0 mm B70f inhale series and one nominal 2.0 mm B70f exhale series for every patient; 18 pairs were clean candidates, patient 05 had unequal slice counts, and patient 04 had different StudyInstanceUIDs. These index fields do not establish DICOM-tag matching or final-tensor comparability.
keystone_residual_assumption: If I have only verified the nearest checkable thing, what am I still assuming? Verifying that paired series exist with matching free-text reconstruction descriptions still assumes that enough pairs have matched DICOM geometry and that the pinned preprocessing does not introduce state-dependent crop, resize, padding, boundary contact, or retained-coverage differences. That remaining assumption is load-bearing and is the real keystone.

stage_0_gate.timing: Freeze the usable-pair threshold and every tolerance before computing any CT-CLIP score.
inspect: Convolution kernel, slice thickness and increment, reconstruction diameter, contrast status, FrameOfReferenceUID, ImagePositionPatient, and series completeness.
Final-tensor physical scale, retained superior and inferior landmarks, crop loss, padding fraction, lung boundary contact, and state-dependent resizing or cropping.
Automatic lung-mask failure rate and whether volume remains computable without human adjudication.
stage_0_gate.decision: GO only if the prespecified minimum number of pairs passes every matching and framing tolerance. Otherwise stop before model inference and report a feasibility result; do not reinterpret failure as a negative biological result.

dies_like_prior: It risks the wrong-keystone failure seen in ideas 005 and 006 if collection-level pair existence is substituted for final-input comparability. This revision differs by marking the real keystone NOT_INSPECTED and making direct DICOM and final-tensor inspection a prospective go/no-go. It does not share the annotation-provenance failures of ideas 001, 002, 003, and 005 because neither X nor the primary readout uses human annotations. It avoids idea 006's extreme out-of-distribution deletion because both arms are real acquisitions, while acknowledging that sharp B70f images may still be out of distribution relative to CT-RATE.

closest_prior_work.citation: Eslick EM et al., Radiother Oncol 2018;127:267-273, PMID 29290405; dataset DOI 10.7937/3ppx-7s22
closest_prior_work.verification: Collection record inspected; paper abstract inspected.
closest_prior_work.delta: The work derives CT ventilation and compares it with Galligas PET; it does not test CT-CLIP or finding-score sensitivity across the breath-hold pair.

closest_prior_work.citation: Foundation model embeddings for quantitative tumor imaging biomarkers, Research Square rs-6630446, PMID 40502795
closest_prior_work.verification: Methods/summary evidence previously inspected; exact overlap should be rechecked before any novelty claim.
closest_prior_work.delta: It studies repeat-scan embedding similarity, not a measured respiratory-state contrast or CT-CLIP emphysema-head change.

novelty_statement: No novelty claim is made. The closest verified work does not answer this exact question, but a final primary-source search is required before describing the audit as previously unreported.

smallest_decisive_experiment.confirmatory_endpoint: Within-patient inspiratory-minus-expiratory change in the CT-CLIP emphysema logit, reported with a paired confidence interval and related descriptively to the automatically measured change in lung volume.
smallest_decisive_experiment.design: Use only the real inhale/exhale BHCT pair. Freeze one confirmatory head (emphysema), one score scale, one direction, one equivalence margin, the usable-pair rule, and the analysis before inference. Preserve patient-level pairing. Do not use labels, train a model, or tune on these cases.
smallest_decisive_experiment.secondary: Atelectasis and lung opacity are ordered secondary heads. The remaining released heads form an explicitly exploratory specificity panel. The 4DCT phases may be used only as an optional exploratory same-volume jitter description if their quality is adequate; they cannot support the main claim.
smallest_decisive_experiment.positive_interpretation: A material, directionally consistent emphysema-score change that exceeds the prespecified margin supports use of degree of inspiration, subject to the acquisition and framing controls.
smallest_decisive_experiment.negative_interpretation: If the confidence interval lies wholly inside a prespecified clinically or model-relevantly small equivalence band, the result is a decisive negative for a material emphysema-score sensitivity in this sharp-kernel cohort. A wider interval is sensitivity-limited, not evidence of invariance.

claim_identifiability.scanner_vendor_site_habitus_referral_pre: Controlled by the within-patient, same-session, single-scanner pair.
claim_identifiability.acquisition_protocol_reconstruction: Not assumed controlled. DICOM matching is required at Stage 0; unmatched pairs are excluded prospectively.
claim_identifiability.patient_positioning: Same-session acquisition reduces but does not eliminate repositioning risk; FrameOfReferenceUID and coordinates are checked, with patient 04 already flagged.
claim_identifiability.preprocessing_framing: The principal unresolved alternative. It is tested on final tensors with prospective tolerances and is a go/no-go condition.
claim_identifiability.label_leakage: No reference labels or reports enter the comparison. Output names remain report-derived semantics, so a changing emphysema head does not identify a specific emphysema image feature.
claim_identifiability.body_habitus: Fixed within patient, although respiratory-state changes in lung-voxel fraction are part of X rather than a habitus confound.
claim_identifiability.sharp_kernel_distribution_shift: Shared by both arms and therefore unlikely to create the paired direction by itself, but it limits external validity and may alter model sensitivity relative to CT-RATE-like reconstructions.

alternative_explanations.alternative: State-dependent crop, scale, padding, or retained anatomy after preprocessing.
alternative_explanations.status: Ruled out only if the prospective final-tensor gate passes; otherwise the study stops.

alternative_explanations.alternative: Reconstruction or coordinate mismatch between inhale and exhale series.
alternative_explanations.status: Ruled out only for retained pairs by direct DICOM inspection; NBIA descriptions alone are insufficient.

alternative_explanations.alternative: General score jitter or broad sensitivity to sharp-kernel radiotherapy CT.
alternative_explanations.status: An all-head exploratory panel can reveal broad instability but cannot prove specificity. This alternative is reduced, not eliminated, because no matched same-state repeat acquisition is confirmed.

alternative_explanations.alternative: A particular respiratory manifestation such as attenuation, vessel crowding, or diaphragm position drives the score.
alternative_explanations.status: Not a rival to the deliberately bundled state-level claim, but it prevents any channel-level interpretation.

anticipated_negative.meaningful_negative: A confidence interval fully inside the preregistered equivalence margin would decisively rule out a material paired emphysema-score effect in the retained B70f cohort.
anticipated_negative.non_decisive_negative: Failure to reject zero, or Stage 0 failure, does not show inspiration invariance. Stage 0 failure is a feasibility result; an imprecise score estimate is sensitivity-limited.

data_and_compute.data: TCIA CT-vs-PET-Ventilation-Imaging, DOI 10.7937/3ppx-7s22, 20 patients, approximately 14.93 GB, CC BY 4.0.
data_and_compute.model: Official CT-CLIP ClassFine checkpoint and pinned preprocessing; checkpoint access remains a click-through dependency.
data_and_compute.compute: Inference on at most 40 primary volumes is compatible with a single Colab Pro+ class GPU.

remaining_legwork: Write and freeze the Stage 0 usable-pair threshold and numeric tolerances.
Download and directly inspect all BHCT DICOM headers and final preprocessed tensors.
Verify the pinned CT-CLIP output vocabulary and score semantics from the exact code/checkpoint revision.
Choose and justify an emphysema-logit equivalence margin before inference.
Complete a final primary-source overlap search before making any novelty statement.

clarity.why: One paired contrast, one automatically measured state variable, and one confirmatory model head.

identifiability.why: The within-patient acquisition controls many standing confounds, but final-tensor framing and same-state jitter remain unresolved and channel-level use is not identifiable.

medical_relevance.why: Inspiratory effort is a routine interpretive concern and materially unstable emphysema scores would threaten comparability, though this is not yet a clinical-outcome study.

interest.why: A real acquired physiological contrast offers a direct audit of a released model; the likely direction is less surprising than its magnitude.

prior_legwork.why: The paired corpus, model, and automatic measurement tools exist, and index inspection narrowed the candidate pairs, but the load-bearing tensor audit remains undone.

feasibility.why: Capped because the keystone is NOT_INSPECTED. The data and inference burden are small, but preprocessing compatibility and checkpoint access remain gates.

data_readiness.why: The images are public and modest in size; actual series geometry still requires inspection and model weights require click-through access.

evaluation_readiness.why: Paired estimation is standard, but the model-scale equivalence margin needs prospective justification.

negative_result_value.why: A successful equivalence test is decisive for material sensitivity in this cohort; an ordinary null remains sensitivity-limited.

novelty_confidence.why: Capped because the keystone is NOT_INSPECTED, and absence of exact overlap has not been established by an exhaustive primary-source audit.

regret.why: The experiment is cheap and uses a rare real paired acquisition, but its external validity is narrow and Stage 0 may stop it.

recommendation: REVISE COMPLETE; require Stage 0 before a feasibility memo or probe contract. No probe code is authorized.
